steps.name: fscale-1-firmware-scale-round
steps.verify: set -o pipefail; R=$PWD; test -z "$(git diff --name-only cf48d9b8 -- main apps/radar apps/weather apps/flights/version.txt apps/flights/editor)" && grep -q 'FL_VALUES_VER 2' apps/flights/main.c && grep -q '== 136' apps/flights/main.c && ! grep -qn '#include.*radar' apps/flights/main.c && python3 apps/sdk/orbsdk.py build apps/flights

steps.name: fscale-2-bake-editor-carrier
steps.verify: set -o pipefail; R=$PWD; test -z "$(git diff --name-only cf48d9b8 -- main apps/radar apps/flights/main.c apps/flights/version.txt)" && grep -q 'VALUES_VER = 2' apps/flights/editor/flights-map.js && grep -q 'VALUES_B = 136' apps/flights/editor/_selftest/bake_check.py && python3 apps/flights/editor/_selftest/bake_check.py && cd $R && test -z "$(git diff cf48d9b8 -- apps/flights/editor/flights-map.js | grep -E '^[+-][^+-]' | grep -v 'VALUES_VER')"

steps.name: fscale-3-pill-wears-theme
steps.verify: set -o pipefail; R=$PWD; test -z "$(git diff --name-only cf48d9b8 -- main apps/radar apps/flights/main.c apps/flights/editor/flights-map.js)" && grep -q 'v1.6.4' apps/flights/version.txt && python3 apps/flights/editor/_selftest/bake_check.py
